snippet.title: American Arcadia | Console Launch Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
Imagine learning your life is a reality TV show, well that's what happened to Trevor...and that's just the start of his bad day! 

American Arcadia is a cinematic puzzle game that combines a 2.5D platformer & first-person gameplay and it's OUT NOW on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch: https://www.americanarcadiagame.com/
